title: Accounting Rules and the Labor Market for Accountants

scopes.description: Complete author-documented master.do workflow, including manual Python notebook stages and downstream empirical branches.

requirements.description: The firm-standard exposure stage requires SEC 10-K text organized in filing-year folders for 1993–2019.

routes.description: Documented local LM10-X and SEC exhibit directory roots exist, but compatible text files and 1993–2019 coverage have not been checked.
routes.expected_period: 10-K filings from 1993–2019, with filing and fiscal year information for the code’s date alignment.

routes.location: SEC EDGAR public filing indexes and filing text
routes.description: EDGAR provides public filings from 1994Q3 onward. The 1993–1994Q2 interval and exact year-folder compatibility remain unverified.

requirements.description: The treatment builder requires the standards-by-year SAS dataset.

routes.description: Code expects Org, Std_Num, Year and total_modal; local readability and coverage are unverified.

requirements.description: The treatment program requires annual firm fundamentals joined on CIK and fiscal year, including the named author-prepared panel and industry classification.

routes.description: This is the file the author program reads; its availability and compatibility were not probed.
routes.expected_period: Annual fundamentals 1990–2020; joined by CIK and fiscal year.

routes.description: The bounded frozen catalog lookup and successful one-row core probe confirm readable COMP.FUNDA fields CIK, FYEAR, GVKEY, SALE and NAICSH. Separate successful one-row probes independently confirm AT and INDFMT; they remain separately cited and are not combined into a synthetic probe. The required author panel uses NAICS, while the raw source exposes NAICSH; mapping, author-panel preparation and full-year coverage remain unverified.
routes.expected_period: Annual raw fundamentals; the author-prepared requirement is 1990–2020, not established by the one-row probes.

requirements.description: The treatment and NSCG workflows require the 2000 state CBP source for employment and NAICS by state.

routes.description: Code specifies the source path and fields, but local availability and vintage are unverified.

The Census page lists the complete 2000 state CBP file; its cited methodology identifies the 1997 NAICS vintage, matching the author's 1997-based join. The public source and vintage are verified; mapping the record layout to emp, naics and fipstate and staging delimited text remain setup tasks.

requirements.description: The industry construction separately requires a 1997-to-2012 NAICS crosswalk.

routes.description: Code names the crosswalk and fields; local availability and mapping vintage have not been checked.

requirements.description: The HERI student-major analysis requires both TFS DISAGG and DEMOGRAPHICS files, joined on SUBJID and YEAR before producing the merged panel.

routes.description: These are author-read student-level sources. Packaged probes establish only aggregate ID lists, not the full analysis microdata. Local availability, waves and field compatibility are unverified.

requirements.description: OEWS employment and maps read annual state workbooks for 1997–2019; employment analysis appends 1997–2018 and maps reads a 2019 file before appending through 2018.

routes.description: Author code specifies yearly workbooks; local availability and coverage are unverified.

BLS confirms annual OEWS availability from 1997 onward and provides downloadable all-year/all-variable data plus historical state tables. This supports 1997–2019 source coverage; exact local naming and workbook mapping are staging tasks. The separate maps issue covers whether the 2019 read belongs in the final output.
routes.expected_period: Annual state occupational estimates 1997–2019; employment appends 1997–2018 and maps reads 2019.

requirements.description: The LinkUp pipeline needs the dated raw postings archive split into 16 CSVs.

routes.description: The author describes LinkUp as vendor-provided. No local copy or specific access restriction was verified.
routes.expected_period: Archive dated 2020-12-31; analysis filters years to 2019 and earlier.

requirements.description: NSCG analyses require public-use survey waves for 2003, 2010, 2013, 2015 and 2017, with wave-specific occupation, location, weight and outcome fields.

routes.description: No local NSCG payload was checked. Code filenames differ from README stems for 2010–2017.

NSF's official listing verifies public-use files for each required year (2003, 2010, 2013, 2015 and 2017). It does not establish that release filenames match the author imports or that every wave contains the required fields, so full input compatibility remains unverified; the exact years are credited as available.

requirements.description: Industry and state treatment builders use the standard-level share-of-restrictive-words workbook.

routes.description: Author code imports this workbook; local availability and content were not checked.

routes.description: These author-named helper tables map state CBP records to abbreviations and NSCG regions; local availability and values were not checked.

requirements.description: The HERI outreach cross-section uses a state-year workbook of accounting outreach program starts.

routes.description: Code reads the hand-collected workbook and expects state/year program fields; local availability was not checked.

routes.description: README identifies the raw review CSV. Active Stata analysis reads a DTA that the source’s commented prep lines would create; neither file was checked.

routes.description: README identifies the vendor database and source files; no local records were checked.

routes.description: Code reads this state-name crosswalk, which is not described in the README; no local file was checked.

issues.description: Mandatory product-level branches remain to be reconciled across all raw reads and the 78 checklist IDs. Generated intermediates and their producers are reviewed separately from raw requirements.

Visible LinkUp stages do not establish how XML output.csv becomes the word-count notebook input/*.csv and then the 76 intermediate/output/output_i.csv files consumed by Stata. An unregistered or manual stage may exist; its split/naming rules and path need confirmation.

The author-prepared Compustat input expects NAICS and annual 1990–2020 records. The local raw source is readable and exposes NAICSH, but its mapping to the required NAICS field, full period coverage and prepared-panel construction remain unresolved.
winsor2 is requested by the supplied Stata programs but the original environment probe reports it unavailable.

Local SEC/LM directory roots exist, but compatible text files and year coverage were not inspected. EDGAR public indexes start at 1994Q3, leaving the author’s 1993 start and early 1994 route unresolved.
Treatment code reads annual firm-standard word-count CSVs for 1993–2019. The manual notebook is configured for one year at a time; output placement and the complete year series need reconciliation.

README lists NSCG stems ecg17/ecg15/ecg13/ecg10/ecg03, while code imports epcg17/epcg15/epcg13/epcg10 and ecg03. The cited NSF listing confirms the five public-use years, not author-compatible SAS filename spelling or wave-specific required-field compatibility. Those checks remain unresolved; no claim is made that a particular field is absent.

README identifies reviews_external_unc.csv as raw input; active analysis reads reviews_external_unc.dta and the source’s CSV import/save preparation is commented out. The conversion and exact input presence are unverified.

master.do uses the same LinkUp header source with a different filename case (linkUp_header.do versus registered linkup_header.do). Align the include spelling to the registered path before a portable run; no operating-system failure was tested.
maps.do reads OEWS workbooks for 1997–2019 but the subsequent append loop ends in 2018. The 2019 workbook is still read by the script, while its role in the final map series is unclear.

These checklist edges are master.do source-to-source includes. The exact code branches and their order are source-proven members of full_pipeline, so they are preserved here as workflow components rather than converted into false raw-data requirements. D0070 has a separate portable case-alignment preparation.
